# rustinion_maintenance_window (Resource)

Manages a maintenance window: notifications for one group (or the whole organization) are held during the window, once or repeating daily/weekly. No in-place update; destroying it cancels it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ends_at` (String) RFC3339, after `starts_at`. A daily window must span under 24 hours, a weekly one under 7 days.
- `name` (String)
- `starts_at` (String) RFC3339, e.g. `2030-01-06T02:00:00Z`.

### Optional

- `group_id` (String)
- `recurrence` (String) `none` (default), `daily` or `weekly`: repeats the same span from `starts_at` until cancelled.
- `scope` (String) `group` (needs `group_id`) or `tenant` (the whole organization). Defaults to `group` when `group_id` is set, else `tenant`.

### Read-Only

- `cancelled_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
